facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: loss of containment at TK-7102 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 19 February 2022 an incident occurred on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
